description: This file implements a security policy module for host environment variable management and sanitization, including functions to block certain environment variables, normalize override keys, and inspect override proposals. It defines a data structure for diagnostics, a sanitization policy with internal checks, and methods for filtering and validating environment variable overrides.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A simple data structure to hold the results of environment override inspection, including lists of blocked and invalid keys.

methods.name: HostEnvSanitizer.inspectOverrides
methods.description: Inspects a set of environment variable overrides, returning diagnostics about blocked and invalid keys.

methods.name: HostEnvSanitizer.sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables and optional overrides, filtering out blocked or invalid entries to produce a safe set of environment variables.
